the magnitude and frequency (in time) of airborne Ambrosia artemsisiifolia pollen in Europe have not changed significantly over the last decade.
there were few significant trends, either positive or negative, in the magnitude and/or frequency of atmospheric Amborsia pollen in Europe.

there are few significant trends in atmospheric pollen concentration or frequency of pollen occurrence in the air, which reflect the changes in sources of pollen, either in the size of the source or in its distance from the monitoring stations.

the spatial and temporal variability in the airborne pollen of Ambrosia in Europe and the possible reasons for these changes.
